recordSource: Reconstructed from git commit fefc6a3 (PR #18) during the Phase 2 MDE hygiene pass. No contemporaneous generation record or validation run was written.
focus: Add a Microsoft site verification meta tag so Bing and Microsoft webmaster tooling can verify domain ownership.
reasonGenerationEnded: Not recorded at the time. Merged via PR #18.

validators.note: The commit added a matching assertion to the validator alongside the meta tag, which is the correct pattern. The run itself was not recorded.
Required status check on the repository, so merge implies it passed.

lessons: Adding the assertion in the same commit as the asserted content is the pattern to keep. It prevents the meta tag from silently disappearing later.
A unit of work that ships to production without a generation record leaves the MDE state lying about what is deployed.
